In supersession of our earlier intimation filed, we are hereby enclosing revised financial results (Consolidated and Standalone) for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

It is hereby clarified that, in the initial filing, the comparative periods in the Statement of Profit and Loss and Statement of Cash Flow in the Consolidated Financial Results were inadvertently mentioned as September 30, 2026, September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2026, instead of September 30, 2026, September 30, 2025 and March 31, 2026 respectively. 

It is hereby clarified that there are no other changes to the Results.
